name: SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation Dataset
description: The SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation dataset was created by the Society for Imaging Informatics in Medicine (SIIM) and the American College of Radiology (ACR) to benchmark machine learning algorithms for identifying and segmenting pneumothorax from frontal chest radiographs. The collection comprises 12,047 de-identified DICOM chest X-ray images (10,675 training images and 1,372 test images). Radiographs positive for pneumothorax are accompanied by fine-grained run-length-encoded (RLE) pixel masks delineating the exact anatomical margins of intrapleural air collections, validated by certified radiologist consensus.
